trigger: an operator upgrades the .deb and reads 'What you will see after the upgrade' before restarting the agent
classification_rationale: the section promised the new behaviour 'after the upgrade', but the deb postinst only reloads and enables (no restart) while the rpm restarts via %systemd_postun_with_restart
summary: Reported by docs-writer, unhappy-path (UP-2) and the architect/release-deploy group (G3-1). Fixed: an Upgrade and rollback paragraph (deb needs a restart, rpm restarts, drop-ins survive, a downgrade leaves /var/lib/yuzu-agent/dmi to delete by hand) and the heading now says once the agent has restarted.

trigger: a release-notes reader scanning the Security section for the widened read reach
classification_rationale: the entry widened what every plugin can read but was filed only under Fixed; the repo files such changes as .security.md fragments
summary: Fixed: split into a Fixed fragment (serial and UUID, the firmware-table copy) and a Security fragment (the any-file read reach, child clearing, the opt-out pointer). Both say a slice of #4916 with no close keyword.

trigger: a customer whose policy forbids ambient capabilities, or who runs SELinux or AppArmor, reads the upgrade note
classification_rationale: nothing pointed policy-constrained customers at the opt-outs and the untested list omitted mandatory-access-control confinement
summary: Fixed: the opt-out section now says to use choice 1 or 2 when a policy forbids ambient capabilities, and the untested list names whether SELinux or AppArmor confines CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH.

trigger: a maintainer reads the privilege-model negative-space row without the unit comment
classification_rationale: the bounding-set rationale lived only in a comment in deploy/systemd/yuzu-agent.service
summary: Fixed: one sentence on the row: the bounding set is exactly this one capability, so neither the agent nor any child can hold another, even through a file capability or a setuid binary; the stated exceptions can add at most this same capability.

trigger: an operator already has a drop-in adding a capability (for example AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE) and upgrades to a unit whose bounding set is one capability
classification_rationale: the upgrade note did not say that existing capability drop-ins must also extend CapabilityBoundingSet=
summary: Probed on a Linux host under systemd 259: the unit still starts and the added capability is silently dropped (CapAmb stays 0x4); adding CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE to the drop-in gives 0x404. The reporter expected a failed start (status 218); the probe showed that was wrong. Fixed: an Existing capability drop-ins paragraph stating the observed result and the fix, scoped to systemd 259.

trigger: an agent launched under a seccomp profile or SystemCallFilter that denies capget, capset or prctl
classification_rationale: the fail-closed refusal in main() (exit before anything else, packaged or not) was undocumented for upgraders; the recorded facts derive MEDIUM, stronger than the reporters' LOW label
summary: Fixed: an If the agent refuses to start paragraph naming the stderr line and the three syscalls to allow.

trigger: a plugin opens a root-only file without O_CLOEXEC and then starts a child with popen or system
classification_rationale: the disclosure listed the exceptions to children not getting the capability but not an inherited open descriptor
summary: Fixed in the disclosure paragraph: a descriptor left open is the third exception; the subprocess runner marks every inherited descriptor close-on-exec; plugins must open such files close-on-exec. No code change.

trigger: a reader follows the opt-out verify path or the privilege-model CI claim
classification_rationale: three accuracy gaps: the privilege-model row claimed CI asserts the check on a live unit while the guide says the CI-job form is untested; no verify step after opt-out 2; no RHEL 8 verify hint
summary: Fixed: the privilege-model row carries the CI-job caveat; opt-out 2 gains test ! -e /var/lib/yuzu-agent/dmi; the untested list tells RHEL 8 to verify with the command above. N1 (dating the heading) was not part of the adopted ruling.

trigger: runuser hangs in PAM or NSS past TimeoutStartSec inside the root ExecStartPre helper
classification_rationale: the unit comment said a leading '-' makes a failed step non-fatal, but systemd does not absorb a start-pre timeout
summary: Fixed by the smaller honest change: the unit comment now says the '-' does not absorb a step that runs past TimeoutStartSec. No timeout prefix on runuser: systemd resolves User= through the same NSS before ExecStartPre, so the hang is not unique to the helper, and changing the root helper's execution path would need a fresh Linux capability check for an INFO item.

trigger: the helper's own stale-pair removal regresses (the rm -rf in its fresh-directory step, or the failure-path remove of dest)
classification_rationale: every unit-path test runs the shipped pre-clean line first and the direct helper cases never seed a stale pair, so the helper's own removal was unobservable
summary: Fixed: a direct helper case in section (v) seeds a stale dmi/ and dmi.tmp in an agent-owned state dir, gives a source with DMI missing, and asserts both are absent.

trigger: the cp that ships the helper in build-deb.sh is deleted or commented out
classification_rationale: the static deb check matched only the chmod line, so removing the cp kept it green
summary: Fixed: comment lines are dropped first and both the cp and the chmod lines are required. Mutation-tested on copies of build-deb.sh: deleting or commenting either line fails the check.

trigger: the capability check hangs on a runner (a systemctl or runuser wait)
classification_rationale: the new step set no timeout-minutes while sibling steps do
summary: Fixed: timeout-minutes: 5 on the step. The PR body states that the yuzu-agent account is created and deliberately never removed (removing it would race concurrent jobs) and that a SIGKILL leaks only /run residue.

trigger: the step runs on every compiler and build-type leg of one host
classification_rationale: the unit and the agent's capability handling do not vary by compiler or build type, and the Gateway real-wire step in the same job already guards to one leg
summary: Fixed: if: matrix.compiler == 'gcc-15' && matrix.build_type == 'debug'. Narrows the blast radius of the runner sudo question below to one leg; it does not settle it.

trigger: a maintainer looks for the capability check among the run-tests.sh targets
classification_rationale: run-tests.sh lists agent-shutdown but did not mention the CI-only capability check
summary: Fixed: one header comment line saying it is CI-only and needs systemd as PID 1 and root (see ci.yml). No new runner target.

trigger: the self-hosted Linux runner's sudoers grant is the apt-family-only one that docs/ci-troubleshooting.md prescribes, and the capability check needs sudo for systemctl, useradd and writes under /run and /var/lib
classification_rationale: a missing precondition is a FAIL in CI by design (never a skip), so an apt-only grant fails the step on every leg it runs on; found independently by two reviewers. The documented grant names runner yuzu-wsl2-linux while ci.yml runs on yuzu-bigtam-linux, so it may not describe the live host at all
summary: Not decidable in code without making the step skip, which the never-skip rule forbids. Open for the project owner: check sudo -n -l as the runner user on yuzu-bigtam-linux (or ask the runner owner) and either widen the grant or rule the step non-blocking, before the PR is raised. The leg guard (h10-G4-1) cuts the blast radius to one leg.

trigger: the capability check leaves a permanent yuzu-agent system account on the shared runner host
classification_rationale: deliberate: the account is created if missing and never removed because removing it would race concurrent jobs sharing the box
summary: No repo change. The disclosure is owed in the PR body together with the h10-Q4 note.

trigger: a future reader of the DMI snapshot (the Linux identity legs) lands
classification_rationale: follow-up candidates, no code in this change: (1) the snapshot is agent-writable after publish, so a future reader must treat it as untrusted (no symlink following, validate shape); (2) two units racing on one state dir delete each other's snapshot, harmless today; (3) only the payload assertion from G4-2 is still a candidate, the named warning from UP-4 was rejected
summary: Filing needs the project owner's go; present them at the push gate.

policy_floor: CLAUDE.md Agent team & governance rule 2 policy floor: a Resource Ledger omission on a C++ diff
trigger: a C++ diff reaches a PR with no committed governance.d fragment and Resource Ledger
classification_rationale: closed policy floor: a Resource Ledger omission on a C++ diff
summary: Gate 7 found no blocking finding in the code (the ledger was stated by the author and independently proven by cpp-safety) and owed only the committed fragment. Closed by this fragment plus governance.d/4916-linux-dmi-privilege.H2w3bM.resource-ledger.md.

refuted_by: CI run 41084727042, job 124162911944 (Linux gcc-15 debug, runner yuzu-bigtam-linux): the capability check's control-unit, snapshot, partial-source and both opt-out sections ran and passed. Those sections need sudo for systemctl, useradd and writes under /run and /var/lib, so the runner's grant is sufficient; every failure on that run follows from the library staging defect fixed in c4f2143e6 (the real agent could not load its library), which is not a sudo failure.
refuted_by_reporter: FortitudeEtc, PR review 5715372384 on b060e15ca (not the change's author), who read the same job log and proposed closing this row on that evidence
summary: Refuted by the first CI run of the step: the sudo precondition holds on yuzu-bigtam-linux. The documented grant naming yuzu-wsl2-linux is a separate documentation question and is not part of this finding.

The PR body (Testing & verification, last bullet) states that the CI step leaves one yuzu-agent account on the runner on purpose so concurrent runs never race on creating it, and that a SIGKILL leaks only /run residue; no repo change was owed.
